selected.rationale: The Wellness Optimizer aligns directly with the advertiser's primary category of general wellness and mid-price tier, matching the persona's low price sensitivity and category affinity for wellness services, and can be effectively reached on Daily Form.

The Fitness Enthusiast matches the advertiser's core mission of feeling better and general wellness services, tying into fitness-oriented offerings and responding well to the fitness and appointment-based focus of Studiogrid.

rejected.reason: The Busy Parent focuses on household and kids products, which does not map to the general wellness services offering of the advertiser.
The Gen Z Aesthete focuses on beauty and fast-moving visual trends, which mismatches the core general wellness services profile.
The Pet Parent is centered exclusively on pet food and pet health, completely unrelated to human wellness services.
The Affluent Classic prioritizes high-end apparel and home goods rather than wellness services.
The Sustainability Buyer focuses on supply chain transparency for goods like sustainable apparel and clean beauty rather than service-based wellness.
The Convenience-First Millennial is oriented around instant delivery and meal kits rather than wellness appointments.
The Value-Conscious Shopper seeks household and grocery bundles, misaligning with the mid-tier service offering.
The Gifter is explicitly disinterested in subscription-only and self-care-only framing, whereas wellness services lean directly into self-care.
